changelog.body:
- Android 10+ support
- Added new ids and removed obsolete ids
- Create multiple profiles/snaps
- Export / Import snaps
- New user interface

readme: # Device Emulator LSposed Module to hide/spoof various android identifiers from third party apps. ## Preview ## Supported Ids - Android Id - Google Service Framwork id (GSF) - Advertisment Id - App Id - Media Drm Id - Manufacturer Code - Type Allocation Code - Hide Phone Number - Hide Emergency Number - Hide Serial Number - Network Carrier - Wifi Name & Mac Address - Bluetooth Name & Mac Address - Fakes Wifi Scan List - Fakes Bluetooth Scan List ## Requirements - Android 10+ - LSposed Framework ## Installation - Install the app - Go to Modules in LSposed - Enable Device Emulator Module in LSposed Framework - Select the apps for which you want to hide ids - Restart the device > [!TIP] > For changes to take effect close all running applications also swipe/clear apps from recent list. No need to reboot. > [!IMPORTANT] > Althought this app has been tested on several devices, there are chances something can go wrong. It is always recommended to have a backup of your device ROM and other important data before trying this app. ### End User Licence Agreement (EULA) This software is provided AS IS with no warranty of any kind, either express or implied. In no event will the author be held liable for any damages arising from the use of this software. ## Support ### Website - https://deviceemulator.dev ### Email - uniquesolution2015@hotmail.com - support@deviceemulator.dev ## Credits - [@LSposed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) - [@Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk)
readmeZh: # 设备模拟器 LSpose 模块可隐藏/欺骗第三方应用程序的各种 Android 标识符。 ## 预览 ## 支持的 ID - 安卓ID - Google 服务框架 ID (GSF) - 广告ID - 应用程序 ID - 媒体 DRM ID - 制造商代码 - 类型分配代码 - 隐藏电话号码 - 隐藏紧急号码 - 隐藏序列号 - 网络运营商 - Wifi 名称和 Mac 地址 - 蓝牙名称和Mac地址 - 假Wifi扫描列表 - 假冒蓝牙扫描列表 ## 要求 - 安卓10+ - LSpose框架 ## 安装 - 安装应用程序 - 转到 LSpose 中的模块 - 在 LSpose 框架中启用设备仿真器模块 - 选择您想要隐藏 ID 的应用程序 - 重新启动设备 > [!提示] > 要使更改生效，请关闭所有正在运行的应用程序，同时从最近列表中滑动/清除应用程序。无需重新启动。 > [!重要] > 尽管此应用程序已在多种设备上进行了测试，但仍有可能出现问题。始终建议在尝试此应用程序之前备份您的设备 ROM 和其他重要数据。 ### 最终用户许可协议 (EULA) 本软件按“原样”提供，不提供任何形式的明示或默示保证。在任何情况下，作者均不对因使用本软件而造成的任何损害承担责任。 ## 支持 ### 网站 - https://deviceemulator.dev ### 电子邮件 - uniquesolution2015@hotmail.com - support@deviceemulator.dev ## 学分 - [@LSpose](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) - [@Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk)
